event.title: Lettuce Recall Issued Due to Cyclospora Contamination Risk
event.canonical_title: Lettuce Recall Issued Due to Cyclospora Contamination Risk
event.summary: Taylor Farms has issued a recall of iceberg lettuce shipped to 27 states due to potential contamination with Cyclospora, a parasite that can cause severe gastrointestinal illness. The affected states include Texas, Florida, Pennsylvania, Illinois, and New Jersey. The FDA has confirmed that a sample of the recalled lettuce tested positive for Cyclospora.
